name: Gadiya Lohar Raw Material Purchase Grant-in-aid Scheme
benefit: - Under this scheme, the member of Gadia Lohar community of Rajasthan receives a one-time financial grant of ₹10,000/- to purchase raw materials for their business.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
   1. The applicant should belong to the Gadiya Lohar community.
